cyborg_recharge_station.notes: Rebuilt as open round-shouldered charging alcove with connected side feet and rear charge ribs. Opaque retracting shutter, no glass. Source 0=open,1=occupied charging,2=closed empty; state dispatch controlled by gameplay. Rear/side fallback surfaces use calm original-palette texels; rigid contact assemblies united to remove coplanar overlaps.

mech_bay_power_port.notes: Charges adjacent front tile, not its own tile. Service hatch and charging-cell anchor.

emitter.notes: Reconstructed from all four directional sprites: narrow flat emitter hood, short muzzle, upright front support, diagonal rear brace and red side conduits. Original side-direction UVs; no rounded capsule head. Beam is runtime attachment. Rear/side fallback surfaces use calm original-palette texels; rigid contact assemblies united to remove coplanar overlaps.

tesla_coil.notes: One tile. Anchored operating form; panel hinge. Electrical arcs are runtime effects, not baked geometry.

grounding_rod.notes: One tile. Anchored operating form; panel hinge. Electrical arcs are runtime effects, not baked geometry.

containment_field_generator.notes: One tile. Power and warmup overlays are source states; external containment spans generated at runtime.

shield_wall_generator.notes: One tile, cardinal field connections. Animated power-state indicator; field wall is a runtime span.

gas_turbine_inlet.notes: One 2m module. Assemble inlet at Y=+2, core=0, outlet=-2 (Blender). Rotor animation is illustrative; speed driven by game.

gas_turbine_core.notes: One 2m module. Assemble inlet at Y=+2, core=0, outlet=-2 (Blender). Rotor animation is illustrative; speed driven by game.

gas_turbine_outlet.notes: One 2m module. Assemble inlet at Y=+2, core=0, outlet=-2 (Blender). Rotor animation is illustrative; speed driven by game.

beam_reflector_single.notes: Separate fixed base and Z-axis rotating head (Godot Y). Source deflector overlay is rotated independently.
